title: Asian tech stocks drop with SK Hynix plunging 10% after Wall Street AI names fall
summary_full: Despite heightened volatility analysts remain optimistic over the outlook of the tech sector, with J.P. Morgan saying the tech sell-off had not derailed the AI investment cycle.
